timing_scope.native_search_fit_seconds: inclusive elapsed through the start of this export; contains earlier completed-iteration conversion/parity/snapshot work
timing_scope.native_export_seconds: this export only, after the preceding elapsed interval
timing_scope.checkpoint_seconds: overlapping subset: earlier completed logger hooks, including conversion/parity/atomic snapshot; never add to search elapsed

coefficient_catalog_scope: input/target dimensions, per-input powers0..2, 2 independent slots per dimension plus input scales; bounded catalog, not completeness

override_order: common source AST budget and supported-operator prior adjustments
physo_profile.scope: preset-derived configuration plus platform extensions; not a quality guarantee; no automatic unit-based preset switch

native_work.scope: actual logger rows/optimizer steps; reward counts can repeat expressions and do not prove convergence

constraint_support.units: native PhysicalUnitsPrior (nonzero epsilon); required portable structural post-filter
constraint_support.max_nodes: weighted source AST prefix-completion prior before sampling; exponent literals and frozen coordinate transforms included
constraint_support.variables: disallowed columns excluded before native search; full-schema export/prediction checked
constraint_support.allowed_variables: native input-column subset with original IDs; no constant-only or mapped-input/template subset fallback
constraint_support.probes: finite-point hard constrained coefficient fit before native reward/RNN update
constraint_support.response_bounds: hard finite-point coefficient constraints before reward
constraint_support.response_checks: finite-step coefficient constraints before reward; not analytic proof
constraint_support.fixed_constants: enforced during search, immutable values/units; native SR rounded-name collisions rejected
constraint_support.power_indices: native n2/n3/n4; rootn uses native signed cbrt only

operator_policy: unavailable_search_operators is the requested/export-capability difference, not decoder reachability; generation enforcement and context-dependent routes are specified by constraint_support and native metadata

candidate_pool.archive_scope: all faithfully exported native candidates, not all internal search states
candidate_pool.quality_scope: Train/shared probes only when explicit bounded allocation is requested; compare owns final eligibility

truncation: none; all faithfully emitted candidates reach common evaluation
reason: Validated saved native hypotheses; search did not complete: Worker exited -9; see worker.log
checkpoint_scope: data-only hypotheses; no optimizer/RNG resume guarantee
work_scope: Counts stop at the validated snapshot; in-flight work and optimizer state are not reconstructed

requirements_ref.scope: canonical common request; native settings/checks are derived evidence

capability_declaration.template_scope: one shared slot, fixed outer coefficients, variable-only calls, identity formal schema; no signed cbrt

constraints.units: native PhysicalUnitsPrior (nonzero epsilon); required portable structural post-filter
constraints.max_nodes: weighted source AST prefix-completion prior before sampling; exponent literals and frozen coordinate transforms included
constraints.variables: disallowed columns excluded before native search; full-schema export/prediction checked
constraints.allowed_variables: native input-column subset with original IDs; no constant-only or mapped-input/template subset fallback
constraints.probes: finite-point hard constrained coefficient fit before native reward/RNN update
constraints.response_bounds: hard finite-point coefficient constraints before reward
constraints.response_checks: finite-step coefficient constraints before reward; not analytic proof
constraints.fixed_constants: enforced during search, immutable values/units; native SR rounded-name collisions rejected
constraints.power_indices: native n2/n3/n4; rootn uses native signed cbrt only

response_enforcement.stage: constrained coefficient fit before native reward and RNN update

constraint_application.max_nodes: weighted source AST prefix-completion prior before sampling; exponent literals and frozen coordinate transforms included

readiness_scope: this profile/run only; execution, fidelity, common admissibility and scientific adequacy are distinct
